maddeler.e:
تنتحروا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِرُوا (tantaḥirū) /tan.ta.ħi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# تُنْتَحَرُوا (tuntaḥarū) /tun.ta.ħa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
